title: Canonical top restriction source isomorphism
statement:
noncomputable def standardSingleBaseChange_topRestriction_sourceIso
    {Y B : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) (M : Y.Modules) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage p).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M) ≅
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage ((⊤ : Y.Opens).ι ≫ p)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (M.restrict (⊤ : Y.Opens).ι))

proof.text: Construct the canonical isomorphism by composing the derived unit for the top-open isomorphism, the derived direct-image composition comparison, and the exact single-complex restriction comparison.
